criteria_assessment.closure: Approved only for the same prepared mathematical domain: the supplied unit C5 pair (0,1,2,3,4) and (5,6,7,8,9) with bridge (0,5), signed scalar form, circular phase, strictly positive capacities, fixed ordinary capacity mean, e=w=1/2, beta=1, a supplied fixed kappa>0, equal constituent measure and one structural clock. The capability is full-state prediction, local all-forward retention and recovery near the aligned winding-one family, and the declared internal receiver response. CT and JO retain all thirty nodal coordinates, node labels, ports, graph, parameters, measure and clock. The regular native resultant chart and positive capacity domain make the full field smooth. JO establishes a local invariant domain and unique all-forward continuation rather than inferring closure from successful samples. Fixing capacity mean and quotienting only the two global origins gives an exact 27-coordinate relative state; absolute outputs retain and reconstruct both origins through their actual rates, which need not vanish. The receiver observations are defined continuous form/phase deformations relative to the prepared shape, not an asserted replacement for predictive state. Structural units and the common clock are declared; no laboratory calibration is implied. No independent pressure state or hidden event memory is consumed. Regional totals, winding, diagnostic tuples and receiver readings are not promoted to autonomous state, and this state is not advertised as a hybrid-runtime checkpoint. This prerequisite approval retains exactly the prepared single-bridge domain above; it does not include acquisition, autonomous support/event creation, an autonomous reduced regional state, a dynamic-capacity graph executor, a universal law or physical mapping. The two-bridge acquisition, selection, concrete witness and quantitative robustness results have separate complete-law proofs and reviews. RB now supplies the symbolic positive radius rho=2^(-2^250) for the same two-bridge matched witness, with all finite premises admitted by one static audit; this is not a practical tolerance or a change to this prepared approval. The first135065 bytes of the chapter remain identical, and the appended RB proof is exactly its frozen reviewed source. Source associations are renewed without changing the evidence anchors or prerequisite scope. A substantive joint review of the established foundation is the next active task; it is not already granted by this renewal. The separate physical-readiness review remains absent. This reviewer performed no scientific evaluation, trajectory, candidate generation or producer replay during renewal.

Pressure is the independently specified current-state constitutive map, never x_dot/nu inferred from an observed response. Resultants, metric, storage, winding and receiver readings are derived observations with explicit availability domains. The relative quotient is an exact symmetry reduction on a fixed mean-capacity leaf, with origins needed for absolute reconstruction.
